SourceProxy.label: 3MF Reader
SourceProxy.name: ThreeMFReader
SourceProxy.Documentation: Reads the triangle meshes of a 3D Manufacturing Format (.3mf) package. Each build item of the model is produced as a partition of the output Partitioned Dataset Collection, with build and component transforms applied. Colors from base materials and color groups are provided as the "Color" cell array, and the source object of each triangle as the "ObjectId" cell array. Objects stored in other model parts using the Production extension are supported.

StringVectorProperty.name: FileName
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Name of the 3MF file to read.

IntVectorProperty.name: ConvertToMillimeters
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: When enabled, point coordinates are scaled to millimeters, whatever the unit of the model. Otherwise, coordinates are kept in the model unit, which is reported by the "Unit" field data array.
